title: Year-End Campaign 2026
tagline: Keep Jewish life warm and open to everyone in Lafayette, Moraga and Orinda.
story:
Every Shabbat dinner, every child at Hebrew school, every holiday celebration and every hospital visit is made possible by people like you.

Your gift keeps the doors of Chabad of Lamorinda open to every Jew, with no membership and no dues. Thank you for being a partner.
